tagline: See how your students actually code
brief: Live Java coding labs in VS Code where instructors see the process, not just the result: integrity signals, rubric-based AI grading, and verifiable certificates. The mark must replace a stock lightning bolt and read at 16 px in a VS Code activity bar.
criteria: Success: avoids dev-tool bracket clichés and edtech blue, recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour, ties to the product's core idea.

concepts.name: Typed C
concepts.idea: Your initial, mid-keystroke: the work is seen as it is written.
rationale: The cursor is the product's core idea: watching the process, not the output
Echoes the blinking emerald caret on the landing page; animates naturally
Two shapes, clear at 16 px; emerald separates it from blue edtech marks

recommendation: Typed C, with the emerald cursor as the single ownable detail. Keep the cursor in every use; the C alone is a generic geometric letter.
next_steps: Apply to favicon, landing page and VS Code extension icon
Optional: blinking-cursor motion for loading states
